entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date 6 months after the date you arrive in Singapore.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento 6 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada a Singapur.
entry.quote: To enter Singapore, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Singapore can be visited without a visa for tourism or business.
entry.es: Se puede visitar Singapur sin visado por turismo o negocios.
entry.quote: You can visit Singapore without a visa for tourism or business.

entry.en: You must complete an electronic SG Arrival Card in the 3 days before you arrive.
entry.es: Debe completar una Tarjeta de Llegada SG electrónica en los 3 días previos a su llegada.
entry.quote: You must complete an electronic SG Arrival Card in the 3 days before you arrive in Singapore.

entry.en: Penalties for drug possession, including cannabis, are severe, and you can be screened for drugs on arrival, including in transit.
entry.es: Las penas por posesión de drogas, incluido el cannabis, son severas, y pueden hacerle pruebas de drogas al llegar, incluso en tránsito.
entry.quote: You can be screened for drugs in your system on arrival in Singapore, including if you’re in transit.

entry.en: Vapes and e-cigarettes are illegal to bring into Singapore.
entry.es: Es ilegal llevar vapeadores y cigarrillos electrónicos a Singapur.
entry.quote:
The following items are also illegal to bring into Singapore:

- vaporisers and e-cigarettes

entry.en: Travellers must declare to customs if carrying more than $20,000 or its foreign currency equivalent in or out of Singapore.
entry.es: Debe declarar en aduana si lleva más de 20.000 dólares o su equivalente en divisas al entrar o salir de Singapur.
entry.quote: you are required to declare to customs if you are carrying more than $20,000 or its equivalent in foreign currency in or out of Singapore.

safety.en: Violent crime and theft are rare in Singapore.
safety.es: El crimen violento y el robo son poco frecuentes en Singapur.
safety.quote: Violent crime and theft are rare in Singapore.

safety.en: Online and phone scams are common and may involve people pretending to be officials or bank employees.
safety.es: Las estafas en línea y telefónicas son comunes y pueden involucrar a personas que se hacen pasar por funcionarios o empleados bancarios.
safety.quote: Online scams and phone scams are common and may involve individuals pretending to be officials or bank employees.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Singapore cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Singapur.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Singapore cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Drinking alcohol in public places other than licensed venues is illegal between 10:30pm and 7am.
safety.es: Beber alcohol en lugares públicos distintos de locales con licencia es ilegal entre las 22:30 y las 7:00.
safety.quote: It is illegal to drink alcohol in a public place, besides restaurants, bars and licensed entertainment venues, between 10:30pm and 7am.

safety.en: Street gatherings and public demonstrations are illegal without police permission, and non-resident foreigners may not attend outdoor demonstrations.
safety.es: Las reuniones callejeras y manifestaciones son ilegales sin permiso policial, y los extranjeros no residentes no pueden asistir a manifestaciones al aire libre.
safety.quote: Avoid street gatherings and public demonstrations as they will be illegal if they do not have police permission.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is legal in Singapore, but the law does not recognise same-sex marriage and partnerships.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es legal en Singapur, pero la ley no reconoce el matrimonio ni las uniones del mismo sexo.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is legal in Singapore. However, the law does not recognise same-sex marriage and partnerships.

health.en: Tap water is safe for drinking in Singapore, according to Wikivoyage.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber en Singapur, según Wikivoyage.
health.quote: Tap water is safe for drinking with very high sanitation standards.

health.en: Dengue fever is endemic to the region, and there are occasional cases of Zika virus.
health.es: El dengue es endémico en la región y hay casos ocasionales de virus del Zika.
health.quote: dengue fever is endemic to the region and there are occasional cases of Zika virus.

health.en: From June to October Singapore can experience high levels of haze pollution from land clearance fires in Indonesia.
health.es: De junio a octubre Singapur puede sufrir altos niveles de contaminación por humo de incendios de desmonte en Indonesia.
health.quote: From June to October Singapore can experience high levels of pollution (haze) from land clearance fires in Indonesia.

health.en: Healthcare in Singapore is of a high quality and expensive.
health.es: La atención sanitaria en Singapur es de alta calidad y cara.
health.quote: Healthcare in Singapore is of a high quality and expensive.

health.en: Travellers should have travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Los viajeros deben tener un seguro de viaje para tratamiento local o evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.quote: Call 995 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: Emergency numbers are 995 for ambulance and fire and 999 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 995 para ambulancia y bomberos y 999 para la policía.

getting_in.en: Changi Airport is the main airport and serves all commercial jet flights.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Changi es el principal y atiende todos los vuelos comerciales a reacción.
getting_in.quote: Changi Airport (SIN IATA) is the main airport and serves all commercial jet flights.

getting_in.en: Seletar Airport serves all turboprop flights and general aviation.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Seletar atiende todos los vuelos turbohélice y la aviación general.
getting_in.quote: Seletar Airport (XSP  IATA) serves all turboprop flights and general aviation.

getting_in.en: Ferries link Singapore with Indonesia's Riau Islands and Malaysia's Johor via the HarbourFront and Tanah Merah terminals.
getting_in.es: Los ferris unen Singapur con las islas Riau de Indonesia y Johor de Malasia desde las terminales HarbourFront y Tanah Merah.
getting_in.quote: Singapore has two terminals that handle international ferries: 5 HarbourFront near Sentosa and 6 Tanah Merah near Changi Airport.

getting_in.en: From Woodlands Train Checkpoint, the Shuttle Tebrau connects to Johor Bahru at JB Sentral station.
getting_in.es: Desde Woodlands Train Checkpoint, el Shuttle Tebrau conecta con Johor Bahru en la estación JB Sentral.
getting_in.quote: The Shuttle Tebrau, operated by Malaysia's Keretapi Tanah Melayu (KTMB), connects 3 Woodlands Train Checkpoint, the last Singaporean railway station, with Johor Bahru at JB Sentral station

getting_in.en: Grab/Gojek rideshare or taxis are the fastest way from Changi Airport to the city, costing about $20–30 including a $5 airport surcharge.
getting_in.es: Grab/Gojek o taxi son la forma más rápida de ir del aeropuerto de Changi a la ciudad, por unos 20-30 dólares con un recargo aeroportuario de 5.
getting_in.quote: Grab/Gojek rideshare or taxis are the fastest way to the city, and will cost about $20–30 including a $5 airport surcharge ($3 for off-peak hours).

getting_around.en: The easiest way to pay for public transport is a contactless Visa, Mastercard or American Express card.
getting_around.es: La forma más fácil de pagar el transporte público es una tarjeta sin contacto Visa, Mastercard o American Express.
getting_around.quote: The easiest way to pay for all public transport is to use a contactless Visa, Mastercard or American Express, which you can use to tap in to and out of any train or bus, including the Sentosa Express.

getting_around.en: Cash is not accepted on the MRT/LRT.
getting_around.es: No se acepta efectivo en el MRT/LRT.
getting_around.quote: Cash is not accepted on the MRT/LRT.

getting_around.en: Eating and drinking, even water, is prohibited in MRT stations and trains, with a $500 fine.
getting_around.es: Comer y beber, incluso agua, está prohibido en las estaciones y trenes del MRT, con una multa de 500 dólares.
getting_around.quote: Eating and drinking (even water) is strictly prohibited in the stations and trains, with offenders being liable for a $500 fine.

getting_around.en: You must tap your device or card on a reader before exiting a bus, or you will be charged the maximum fare.
getting_around.es: Debe pasar su tarjeta o dispositivo por el lector antes de bajar del autobús, o se le cobrará la tarifa máxima.
getting_around.quote: Remember to tap your device or card against a reader before you exit a bus. Otherwise, you will be charged the maximum fare.

getting_around.en: The Singapore Tourist Pass gives unlimited rides for $17/24/29 for 1/2/3 days.
getting_around.es: El Singapore Tourist Pass da viajes ilimitados por 17/24/29 dólares para 1/2/3 días.
getting_around.quote: The Singapore Tourist Pass (STP) gives you unlimited rides for $17/24/29 for 1/2/3 days respectively

getting_around.en: Rideshare apps have largely supplanted taxis in Singapore, the biggest being Grab and Gojek.
getting_around.es: Las aplicaciones de transporte han reemplazado en gran medida a los taxis en Singapur, las mayores son Grab y Gojek.
getting_around.quote: Rideshare apps have largely supplanted taxis in Singapore. The two biggest players are Grab and Gojek.

money.en: The Singaporean currency is the Singapore dollar (SGD), divided into 100 cents.
money.es: La moneda de Singapur es el dólar singapurense (SGD), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The Singaporean currency is the Singapore dollar, denoted by the symbol S$ or $ (ISO code: SGD). It is divided into 100 cents

money.en: Most retailers and service providers in Singapore are required to levy a 9% GST.
money.es: La mayoría de comercios y proveedores de servicios en Singapur deben cobrar un 9% de GST.
money.quote: Most retailers and service providers in Singapore are required to levy a 9% GST.

money.en: Singapore has adopted cashless payments in a big way, and credit and debit cards are widely accepted.
money.es: Singapur ha adoptado ampliamente los pagos sin efectivo y las tarjetas de crédito y débito son ampliamente aceptadas.
money.quote: Singapore has adopted cashless payments in a big way and it's possible that you won't see cash during your entire visit.

money.en: The main local banks are DBS, UOB and OCBC, whose ATMs let you withdraw money via the Plus/Cirrus networks.
money.es: Los principales bancos locales son DBS, UOB y OCBC, cuyos cajeros permiten retirar dinero mediante las redes Plus/Cirrus.
money.quote: The main local banks are DBS, UOB and OCBC, whose ATMs can be found in every shopping mall or MRT station, and all of which let you withdraw money via the Plus/Cirrus networks.

money.en: Tipping is generally not practised in Singapore, though hotels and restaurants commonly levy a 10% service charge.
money.es: Generalmente no se da propina en Singapur, aunque hoteles y restaurantes suelen cobrar un 10% de servicio.
money.quote:
Tipping is generally not practised in Singapore. However, it is common for hotels and restaurants to levy a 
10% service charge before GST

money.en: Tipping is not expected in taxis.
money.es: No se espera propina en los taxis.
money.quote: Tipping is not expected in taxis, who usually return your change to the last 10 cents

etiquette.en: Public display of affection is frowned upon: holding hands is fine, but making out in public is considered impolite.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto están mal vistas: tomarse de la mano está bien, pero besarse apasionadamente se considera descortés.
etiquette.quote: public display of affection is still frowned upon: holding hands is fine, but making out in public is considered to be impolite.

etiquette.en: Most places of worship require conservative dress, with no bare shoulders or midriff and no shorts or skirts above the knee.
etiquette.es: La mayoría de los lugares de culto exigen vestimenta conservadora, sin hombros ni abdomen descubiertos ni shorts o faldas sobre la rodilla.
etiquette.quote: Most places of worship require visitors to be conservatively dressed - no bare shoulders or midriff, and no shorts or skirts above the knee-cap.

etiquette.en: If invited to a home, always remove your shoes before entering.
etiquette.es: Si lo invitan a una casa, quítese siempre los zapatos antes de entrar.
etiquette.quote: If invited to somebody's house, always remove your shoes before you enter as most Singaporeans do not wear their shoes at home.

etiquette.en: Do not point at statues of deities in Chinese temples with your index finger, as this is considered very rude.
etiquette.es: No señale con el dedo índice las estatuas de deidades en los templos chinos, pues se considera muy grosero.
etiquette.quote: When visiting Chinese temples, do not point at the statues of deities with your index finger, as this is considered to be very rude.

etiquette.en: Saving face is very important, so you should generally not point out other people's mistakes.
etiquette.es: Salvar las apariencias es muy importante, por lo que en general no se deben señalar los errores ajenos.
etiquette.quote: saving face is very important in Singaporean culture. You should generally not point out other people's mistakes in order not to cause major embarrassment

etiquette.en: The standard greeting is a firm handshake, and Singaporeans are punctual.
etiquette.es: El saludo habitual es un apretón de manos firme, y los singapurenses son puntuales.
etiquette.quote: Singaporeans are punctual, so show up on time. The standard greeting is a firm handshake.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards are sold at 7-Eleven, telecom shops, currency exchange counters and Changi Airport, and require a passport to register.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM prepago se venden en 7-Eleven, tiendas de telecomunicaciones, casas de cambio y el aeropuerto de Changi, y requieren pasaporte para registrarse.
connectivity.quote: Travellers can obtain prepaid SIM cards from 7-Eleven convenience stores, telecommunication shops, currency exchange counters, and at Changi International Airport. An international passport or Singapore ID is required to register for the SIM card.

connectivity.en: Free Wi-Fi is standard at paid accommodations, and public Wi-Fi is common but not everywhere.
connectivity.es: El Wi-Fi gratuito es habitual en los alojamientos de pago, y el Wi-Fi público es común pero no está en todas partes.
connectivity.quote: Free Wi-Fi is standard at paid accommodations, and public Wi-Fi is common but not everywhere.

connectivity.en: Near Malaysia, such as Woodlands, your phone may switch to a Malaysian network and incur roaming charges.
connectivity.es: Cerca de Malasia, como en Woodlands, su teléfono puede cambiar a una red malasia y generar cargos de roaming.
connectivity.quote: your phone may automatically switch to a Malaysian network, incurring international roaming charges even though you haven't left Singapore.

connectivity.en: WhatsApp is the most common messaging app used in Singapore.
connectivity.es: WhatsApp es la aplicación de mensajería más usada en Singapur.
connectivity.quote: WhatsApp is the most common messaging app used in Singapore

connectivity.en: Internet censorship is generally restricted to pornography, gambling and copyright violating websites.
connectivity.es: La censura de internet se limita generalmente a pornografía, juegos de azar y sitios que violan derechos de autor.
connectivity.quote: Internet censorship is generally restricted to pornography, gambling and copyright violating websites.
